description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers alert classification and the malformed-page contract. Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours this skill deliberately does not own: signal existence (logging-monitoring), the go/no-go verdict (operational-readiness), running an open incident (incident-commander), dashboard layout (dashboard-design) and host security (server-hardening).
